subject.title: feat(ui): Labs settings page for experimental feature toggles

question: Should OpenClaw make a registry-driven Control UI Labs page the supported core surface for enabling experimental capabilities such as Code Mode, rather than keeping those controls configuration-only until each feature has dedicated UX?
rationale: The patch introduces a durable Settings information architecture and discoverability contract for experimental features; source review can validate mechanics but cannot determine the intended product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor Labs with a narrow contract
options.body: Approve Labs as a core experimental-feature registry after the stale-snapshot repair and live Gateway-backed proof are supplied.

options.title: Keep experimental gates config-only
options.body: Do not add the generic Labs surface yet; let individual experimental features bring their own approved setup UX when ready.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Labs with a narrow contract
recommendation.body: Approve Labs as a core experimental-feature registry after the stale-snapshot repair and live Gateway-backed proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked Swarm proposal and this PR place Labs in the same experimental-feature product direction.
